title: A single Claude /review-code child can't cover a large (15-path, about 1.4k-line) contribution: it hits memory exhaustion or drops lenses, so the pair stalls; partition the review by a path ledger
outcome: A single Claude /review-code child can't cover a large (15-path, about 1.4k-line) contribution: it hits memory exhaustion or drops lenses, so the pair stalls; partition the review by a path ledger
acceptance: /review-changes partitions a contribution above a stated size (paths or changed lines) into fixed path groups per vendor. Every group is reviewed with ALL lenses by a read-only child of that vendor on the same frozen input, and a coverage ledger records each path's full read and owner traces. The groups together count as that vendor's ONE review.

An incomplete group (missing lens, path, attestation or record) is reported as incomplete coverage for that group only, and only that group is re-reviewed; it never silently counts and never restarts the whole pair.
The instruction change follows the repository's rule for instruction and command files, and is checked by use on a real large contribution, not by a test that reads the Markdown.
